messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "children weighing at least 132 pounds (60 kilograms)"
set: ["children weighing at least 132 pounds (60 kilograms)", "children weighing at least 43 kg", "children at least 10 years old", "at least 2% of children and teenagers", "treatment for at least 5 days in children", "children who weigh less than 5.7 pounds (2.6 kg)", "at least five days", "adults and children who are at least 6 years old", "anxiety in adults and children at least 7 years old", "at least 6 years old", "asthma attacks in adults and children at least 2 years old", "for use in adults and children who are at least 2 years old", "adults and children at least 2 years old with symptoms of seasonal allergic rhinitis", "exercising at least 30 minutes most days", "take at least 4 hours before resin", "take at least 8 hours before aspirin"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
